lines: Características: acolhe sem pressionar ("Apenas relaxe..."); curiosa mas paciente; calor humano.
Red flags: soar fria, clínica ou impaciente; formalidade excessiva.
Haku (protagonista, narração 1ª pessoa) — `voice_criticality: high`. Predomina nas 2 cenas:
Características: sentenças curtas e definitivas; duplo sentido ("um mundo totalmente novo te espera"); ambiguidade ameaçadora.
Red flags: soar caloroso/paternal; resolver a ambiguidade (a fala deve permanecer dúbia).
Registro: erudito cômico, pomposo e arcaico; bajulador do Ukon; alívio cômico.
Características: fala arcaica/empolada (equivalente a "vós/peço-vos/meus olhos não me enganam") + gag de cicio (s→sh, ex.: "SHEEKETH"/"shir"); melodramático; gruda no Haku como "benfeitor".
Red flags: perder o arcaísmo ou o cicio (são a piada); soar moderno/neutro; explicar a comédia. Manter o contraste entre a pompa do vocabulário e a fragilidade do personagem.

Oshtor — `voice_criticality: high`. = Ukon até 13_08 (ver spoiler_ledger). Registro formal, nobre, comedido; General da Direita. Antes do reveal, traduzir como o mercenário "Ukon" (espirituoso, informal) — NÃO antecipar a pompa de general
Características: frases quebradas por reticências; perguntas curtas ("Quem... é você...?"); pouca pontuação forte.
Red flags: falas fluentes/articuladas demais; perder o tom de torpor; pontuação "limpa" que apaga a fragmentação.
Registro: guerreiro carismático, espirituoso, caloroso e informal; líder nato que trata Haku como um irmão mais novo.
Características: desembaraçado, brincalhão, generoso; fala direta e cativante; autoridade leve (lidera a Coorte) sem arrogância.
Red flags: soar rígido/formal/militar demais (a graça é justamente o contraste com a patente); frieza. SPOILER: não deixar a tradução insinuar a identidade verdadeira — no cap.12 ele é só "Ukon".

decisions.title: Opcode de RÓTULO DE FALANTE `53 00` + reconcile de speaker (data-driven)
decisions.summary: **Problema:** in-game, o rótulo de falante aparecia em **inglês** ("Girl") mesmo com a tradução ("Garota") aprovada e gravada. RE: o nome do falante usa um **2º opcode de ponteiro, `53 00`** (mesmo formato file-relativo do `50 00` de diálogo), que o conector ignorava. Resultado: "Girl"→"Garota"

decisions.title: Gate de charset pt-BR — método e veredito
decisions.summary: **Decisão tomada:** Marcar `target_charset_supported: likely` e exigir confirmação in-game antes de produção. **Alternativas consideradas:** - Confirmar por presença no texto-fonte — **insuficiente**: o fonte é inglês e quase não usa acentos (só `õ` e `À` aparecem em texto real).

A tradução canônica (`approved_translations.csv`, `translation_plan.json`) **mantém os acentos** (correta para QA/revisão); apenas os bytes escritos no jogo são dobrados para ASCI

lines.source: Wh-What is the meaning of this!?
Spittle flies from Dekopompo's mouth as he\n
rages.
This is...
Raiko, much calmer than his fellow Pillar,\n
surveys his surroundings with a furrowed brow.
Their combined forces beat a hasty retreat to\n
the capital upon the news of the Mikado's\n
death...
I DEMAND to know what's going on here!\n
Our liege is DEAD, and we're barred from\n
entering the city!?
I'll have none of this! Where are the guards!?\n
I am Dekopompo of the Eight bloody Pillar\n
GENERALS!
Dekopompo barks at the guard post atop the\n
high gates, but no answer comes.
ANSWER! I'll break these wretched gates down\n
MYSELF if I have to!
Are you going to let him carry on like that?
What do you mean?
At this rate, he could well follow through on\n
his threats and order an assault on the gates.
Hah, as if that would accomplish anything.\n
Even as one, our armies would not budge the\n
imperial gate.
And such an order would be grounds for treason.
Truth be told, it would do my heart good to see\n
this odious cur removed from my sight.
That--
RAIKO! How can you be so calm at a time like\n
this!?
Dekopompo turns his fury on Raiko, spitting and\n
flailing, but Raiko continues ignoring him.
Any news from the Tiriryarai?
Well...
Hmph. Finally, some movement.
NYEH!?
Beside the gates, a much smaller passage opens,\n
and through it steps--
Woshis...?
Woshis. What exactly is happening here?
As the two generals look upon him, demanding\n
answers, Woshis speaks with a grave expression.
My apologies for keeping the two of you waiting.\n
Our liege's death has thrown the court into\n
chaos.
I don't want your excuses!
Dekopompo barks sharply at Woshis, his entire\n
head reddening to the point of threatening\n
to steam.
What is the meaning of this!? The Mikado is\n
DEAD. It is our duty as PILLARS to stand firmly\n
inside th--
Woshis quietly cuts Dekopompo off with a curt\n
shake of his head.
I'm afraid I cannot permit that. The gates are\n
to remain closed so none may enter--nor exit.
It is the command of Her Highness that the\n
capital mourns in silence and isolation.
Nyeh!?
This is preposterous! What purpose do the Eight\n
Pillars serve if we cannot enter OUR OWN CITY?
I advise you watch your tongue, Lord Dekopompo.\n
This order comes directly from the princess.
Or perhaps you wish to draw your blade against\n
her and seize power while the empire is in\n
disarray?
Gah, I-I would never--That's a BASELESS\n
accusation, you...
Dekopompo immediately becomes flustered at the\n
insinuation of treason.
Her Highness is the blood of the Mikado, born\n
and bred to rule. Her word is absolute.\n
However...
Her Highness is still naught but a young girl.\n
I highly doubt she's in any state to give\n
orders.
Therefore, I can only assume she's been advised--\n
or worse, coerced into making this decree.
Raiko steps forward, putting himself\n
face-to-face with Woshis.
Lord Woshis, thank you for conveying\n
Her Highness' will to me.
However, we are generals sworn to protect our\n
princess. Will you not let us pass, if not our\n
armies?
I should like to see her in person and express\n
my condolences.
At Raiko's words, Woshis nods.
I understand this, Lord Raiko.
However, I have not the authority to overturn\n
a direct order from the imperial princess.
I shall have to express your wish to Her Highness\n
and return to you. Please, I ask for your\n
patience.
Hyargh!? We have no time for such things!\n
I will ask Her Highness in person about this!
Dekopompo angrily storms toward the gates...
...only for Woshis to efficiently and calmly\n
block his path.
I would advise against that.
HNENGH!?
Have you not eyes to see?
Dekopompo follows Woshis' gaze up the wall,\n
then freezes.
Raiko also looks up at the parapet, clenching\n
his teeth tensely.
So, this is HIS doing?
Vurai.
Atop the walls, soldiers stand at the ready with\n
arrows nocked and bowstrings drawn, aiming\n
downward.
That armor... That's Vurai's livery. What sort\n
of bluff is he playing at, threatening us so...?
No. Calculated posturing is beyond him.\n
He must truly believe he can stand against us\n
all, even Woshis.
Raiko quickly glances toward Woshis.
If you disobey an imperial command, I will have\n
no choice but to find you both guilty of high\n
treason.
So, how you will choose?
Y-You...!
I see. He earned the princess' trust while we\n
all played at war, and now he stages a coup...
When those gates open, the dust will have\n
settled. A man unhappy in peacetime WOULD\n
contrive this.
Who knows? I certainly can't speak to any such\n
plot.
But I will say this: absolute rule--even by a\n
god--stifles. A vessel under pressure is bound\n
to burst.
Within the next few years, perhaps even months,\n
this empire will fracture. Yamato is doombound.
And you think Vurai is the man to place your\n
faith in, to prevent that?
Even an overflowing vessel is preferable to a\n
shattered one.
So, you've accepted a passive role and decided\n
to wait out the storm.
I wish merely to spare my countrymen the horrors\n
of war. I advise you pursue a similar path.
The transition should not take long.\n
Of this I am certain.
Woshis bows deeply, then retreats behind the\n
gates via the small passage he emerged from.
Vurai... You've surely done it now.
And here I thought to accelerate my own plans.\n
You've beaten me to the punch.
But do not think that I, Raiko, will take this\n
lying down...
